review_notes: I read the whole file. I grepped Mathlib for other structures or definitions named like TransfiniteComposition. The only other one is `MorphismProperty.TransfiniteCompositionOfShape` in MorphismProperty/TransfiniteComposition.lean. It `extends CategoryTheory.TransfiniteCompositionOfShape J f` and reuses its API, for example `h.toTransfiniteCompositionOfShape.ofArrowIso e` and `.map F`. That is deliberate layering, as the file's docstring says, so it is not a competing concept. RelativeCellComplex also extends the structure. The other constructions here are `ofComposableArrows`, `ofOrderIso`, `iic` and `ici`. They use existing Mathlib notions: `IsWellOrderContinuous`, `IsColimit`, `Set.initialSegIic`, `Subtype.mono_coe` and `Functor.Final`. I found no parallel reimplementation of an existing Mathlib concept. I did not search every Mathlib file exhaustively for a similarly shaped structure under another name.
